title: Score survey data and assign wealth quintiles — et_score
text: data data frame respondent answers, one row per household. tool equitytool object et_parse_workbook(). scope One "national", "urban", "rural" "sample". See Details. vars Optional named character vector mapping question names columns data, e.g. c(Q1 = "tv", Q2 = "mobile"). area variant == "rural_urban" tools, vector marking row urban rural. Either column name data vector long nrow(data). Values matched leniently: 1/"urban"/"u" mean urban 2/"rural"/"r" mean rural (case-insensitive). weights Optional survey weights, used scope = "sample". Either column name data numeric vector. probs Cut-point probabilities scope = "sample". Defaults quintiles, c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). title: Score survey data and assign wealth quintiles — et_score
text: scope decides quintiles relative , substantive choice, technical one. "national" Published national cut-points. Quintile 1 poorest fifth country time source survey. targeted non-representative sample quintiles evenly filled – intended behaviour usually finding. "urban" Published urban cut-points, surveys urban residents. Position relative national urban population. "rural" Rural cut-points, tool publishes . tools ; see note . "sample" Cut-points computed sample's weighted score distribution. Quintile 1 poorest fifth respondents, groups approximately equal size construction. Use relative position within surveyed population want report, say explicitly – national quintiles. Use et_scopes() see published scopes given tool supports. currently published corpus 14 "rural + urban" tools provide national urban cut-points rural ones: rural score intermediate quantity rescaled onto national scale. tools use scope = "national" area, scope = "sample".

what: rEquityTool: Wealth Scores and Wealth Quintiles from 'EquityTool' Questionnaires — rEquityTool-package
title: rEquityTool: Wealth Scores and Wealth Quintiles from 'EquityTool' Questionnaires — rEquityTool-package
text: Reads country workbooks published 'EquityTool' (https://equitytool.org), simplified asset-based measure relative household wealth derived Demographic Health Survey Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey wealth indices, applies survey data. Given data frame respondent answers, package computes 'EquityTool' wealth score assigns respondents wealth quintiles using published national, urban rural cut-points, using sample's weighted score distribution relative position within surveyed population quantity interest. Response coding validated scoring, score tables cross-checked two independent representations workbook.
